messages:
maria-hr: Hey team :wave: Quick coordination thread for Devon (remote hire) — I-9 verification options and day-1 logistics. Wanted to get sign-off on process and who owns what.
jamal-peopleops: Thanks Maria. Remote I-9s: we can do 1) local in-person partner (ID verification kiosk), 2) mobile notary visit, or 3) employee visits nearby office if convenient. Which does Devon prefer?
tyler-it: FYI for provisioning: laptop imaging takes ~48 hours after the ticket is created. If we need hardware on day 1 we must kick it off today. Also need a shipping address and whether they want a dock.
maria-hr: Good call. Devon—what's your preference for I-9? Also can you drop a preferred shipping address for laptop?
devon-newhire: Hi all — I can do the kiosk option near me. There's a UPS Access Point 10 min away. Also available Tue/Wed mornings. Shipping address is my home address: 123 Maple St, Apt 4.
jamal-peopleops: Kiosk is fine. We need to send the kiosk authorization code and the list of acceptable docs. I'll generate the code and DM Devon. Note: for remote hires using kiosk we still require original documents presented in person at the kiosk.
maria-hr: Copy. Docs reminder (I-9):
```
List A OR (List B + List C)
List A examples: U.S. passport, Permanent Resident Card
List B examples: Driver's license
List C examples: Social Security card, birth certificate
```
maria-hr: If anyone needs the full CHRO checklist, I can paste the link. Also reminder: if they only have copies, they must use the notary option.
tyler-it: @maria-hr I'll create the laptop ticket now. Tagging required: "newhire-devon-1771". Please confirm if they need VPN access day-1 or we can grant after 24h once MFA is set?
devon-newhire: Would prefer VPN day-1 if possible, need to access internal docs during orientation.	tyler-it: We'll try for same-day: I'll flag as priority but still needs HR approval for SSO groups.
jamal-peopleops: Benefits note: Open enrollment window for new hires is 30 days from start date. For Devon, that starts on their first day (orientation). We'll send the BenAdmin welcome email within 24 hours of start. Also need DOB and SSN for benefits setup (secure form on ADP). Maria, can you confirm we have those?
maria-hr: I have DOB on file, still waiting for the SSN (Devon, you can upload securely via the onboarding portal). Also we'll ask Payroll to prefill tax form based on state.
onboard-bot: Reminder posted: "New hire orientation checklist created for devon-newhire. Schedule invite sent: Day 1 | 10:00-13:00 PT — Intro, benefits walkthrough, security setup, team sync." (automated)
maria-hr: Day-1 run of show draft:
- 10:00 - 10:20 Welcome + company intro
- 10:20 - 10:50 Benefits + payroll (Jamal)
- 10:50 - 11:20 IT security + MFA (Tyler)
- 11:20 - 12:00 Team intro + onboarding tasks
- 12:00 - 12:30 Q&A and next steps
Please review and flag any missing item.
jamal-peopleops: Add "enrollment deadline explanation" to benefits slot. Also confirm timezone — Devon's in PST?
devon-newhire: Yes PST. Also quick Q — background check: I submitted via Checkr last week, seen "in progress". Anything else I need to do?
maria-hr: Checkr normally takes 48-72 hours. If it stalls past 5 business days, ping me and I'll escalate. No further action from your side unless they ask for documents.
tyler-it: One more: bring a personal phone for MFA setup. If Devon doesn't have one, we'll schedule a short hands-on session.
devon-newhire: Got it, I have a phone.
maria-hr: Thanks all. Action items summary:
- jamal-peopleops: generate kiosk auth code + DM Devon (due today)
- tyler-it: create laptop ticket "newhire-devon-1771" and attempt same-day VPN access (due today)
- devon-newhire: upload SSN securely to onboarding portal and confirm kiosk appointment (due by Mon)
- maria-hr: send orientation calendar invite with Zoom link and attach benefits packet (due today)
If anything slips, post here so we can track. :thumbsup:
jamal-peopleops: Kiosk code created and DM'd to Devon (code: `KSK-9X4B`). Reactions: :white_check_mark:
tylor-it: (typo) typo on username — actually it's me, tyler-it, ticket created: IT-12345. ETA imaging complete by tomorrow EOD.
devon-newhire: Confirmed I got the kiosk DM and booked Tue 9:30am slot. Uploaded SSN to portal.
maria-hr: Awesome, closing loop. If background check clears before Tue I'll mark them as cleared; otherwise we'll proceed with orientation as scheduled and finalize offer contingencies later.
onboard-bot: "Task update: laptop ticket IT-12345 moved to 'in progress' — ETA 24h." (automated)
maria-hr: Thanks team — feel free to add any follow-ups."
